tagline: 理光便携相机，1985 年发布
description: 理光于1985年推出的便携相机。配备Rikenon Lens 35mm f/2.8, 5 elements in 5 groups。快门速度Programmed, 2 sec. - 1/500 sec.。感光度ISO 25 - 1600 (DX-code system), Capable of manual ISO setting, 1/3 step increments。Single-point active autofocusing system, 10 focusing zones, Pre-focus facility。

specs.镜头: Rikenon Lens 35mm f/2.8, 5 elements in 5 groups
specs.对焦: Single-point active autofocusing system, 10 focusing zones, Pre-focus facility
specs.感光度: ISO 25 - 1600 (DX-code system), Capable of manual ISO setting, 1/3 step increments
specs.英文简介: The FF-70 is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1985 as the successor to their FF-3 AF.
